items.html: (And it seems to me, as I wrote above, that only the Mochin of Bina was repaired in the nursing entirely, and it is hinted at in the Hei of Elokim. Therefore in it the form and the distinction changed — between the Bina of Bina, and the Bina of Hochma, and the Bina of Daat. And understand this well — from the Ari, of blessed memory.)
